blocks.text: ● A unit is made up of 1 or 2 machines. A unit of 2 machines is called a {o|Twin Unit}, and a unit of 1 a {o|Single Unit}.
● On the map, the {o|"Join"} unit command forms a Twin Unit and {o|"Disband"} forms Single Units. To join, the units must be adjacent within the 8 surrounding squares.
• Ability effects combine the Abilities equipped on both machines, and both machines get them.
• Both machines can attack, so you can deal more damage to enemies in a single battle.
